main_text.p: Murus exufu Chaldaico : plur. שוּרִים Inimici; שׁוּרוֹת & שׁוּרָה Muri.
שׁוּר m. Bos : plur. שׁוֹרִים. R. Bechai notat, sic dici bovem, quod formam habeat conspicuam & Visu insignem.
הַשּׁוּרָה f. Munus, Donum, sic dictum, quòd ad id homines Respiciant.
שׁוּר Principatum tenere vel gerere, Principem agere: conjt.cum אֶל & עַל. Hiphil הַשִּׁיר Principem constituere.
שַׂר m. Princeps: plural. שָׂרִים Fœmin. cum Joth paragogico שָׂרָתִי, Princeps fœmina: plur. שָׂרוֹת.
מְשׂוּרָה f. Mensura, quasi rerum dividenda-rum Domina & principissa.
שׂוּשׂ Gaudere, Lætari: Hiph. הַשִּׂישׂ Idem.
שׂוּרֵת Ponere, Disponere, Proponere, Appo-nere: Hiphil הַשִּׂית idem. Hoph. הוּשַׂת Poni, Imponi.

page.notes: Hebrew words are printed with vowel points as on the scan; the catchword "שתות" sits at the lower right. Some vowel points and dagesh marks are uncertain at this scan resolution.
